title: Brief
description: Container for one weekly sensing brief (A-2): the period it covers, its freeze date (provenance.frozenOn) and which signals it contains. It holds signal identifiers, not signals, so a signal's text exists in exactly one place. The order of signalIds carries no meaning: the UI orders by publication date (C-4), so the Brief Editor cannot express a preference through list position. The upper bound BRIEF_SIGNAL_CAP is not set here because its value is open (Q-3); the M5 unit test enforces it. Shipped in data/brief.js.

label.description: The brief as an assembled whole is frozen content; its signals carry their own labels.
